Benchmarked zero-shot ultrasound foundation models (UltraSAM, SAMUS) against the dataset.

title: Spotifulyflie: local Spotify library analyzer
summary: A local-first Python app for organizing a Spotify library: it syncs Liked Songs and playlists into SQLite and adds search, filtering and reversible playlist edits.
highlights: Hand-written Spotify API client with an OAuth PKCE flow and an incremental, resumable sync.
Custom search query language (fields, ranges, negation, sorting) shared by the UI filter panel.
Playlist writes are logged with per-operation undo, so a network failure leaves a reversible state.

title: Resume Assistant
summary: A personal tool that stores my experience as verified facts in SQLite and generates tailored applications, where every generated line traces back to its source.
highlights: Parses past resumes into a deduplicated SQLite store of reusable resume bullets.
SQL triggers enforce data provenance: every generated line traces back to a stored source record, or the system halts.
A separate pass converts legacy project folders into reviewable entries without a model reading the underlying code.
